new_constructors.meaning: Recipients designated only by the enclosed exact current-source wording, without equating them to employees, professional advisers, contractors, or the unrestricted third-party class.
new_constructors.name: source_other_recipients

new_constructors.meaning: The material class bounded by the enclosed exact current-source wording when ordinary confidential-information, copy, or derivative constructors would change its scope.
new_constructors.name: source_stated_information

new_constructors.meaning: Expiration or termination of the source-defined Project, distinct from Agreement termination and from a general business relationship ending.
new_constructors.name: project_end

new_constructors.meaning: The enclosed trigger subject to the exact source-stated deadline, ordering, or other temporal qualification retained as text.
new_constructors.name: qualified_trigger

new_constructors.meaning: An operative role, purpose, or applicability condition retained in exact current-source wording when a narrower existing condition would overstate it.
new_constructors.name: source_stated_condition

new_constructors.meaning: A current-source clause whose wording places stated persons within a confidentiality context but omits enough language that no disclosure permission or prohibition is supplied by the program.
new_constructors.name: source_elliptical_clause

value.rationale: 本次更新不再增加对当前 G 无因果影响的神经读取，而是在查询前直接补齐来源局部语义。程序保留全部 incoming statements，并新增：6fce 中相互独立的请求返还、Project 结束后限期销毁、Agreement 结束/请求返还、备份档案留存、法务部门争议副本留存及持续保密限定；8fb 中仅由请求触发的全部材料返还，并把其省略式人员保密句保留为未解析描述；a5b0 中 Visitor 对来源所称“others”的明确披露禁止，同时不把它扩张为员工、顾问或一般第三方类别。处置动作分别绑定自己的材料、触发、期限和例外，受控实体角色也不扁平化。组合阶段只转发已类型检查的来源输出，消费者继续保留既有正、负和未处理残差路径；没有完整证据时不会制造 NotMentioned。该更新未运行 U，U 的 phi/G 字典仍为空，也不承诺总体得分提升；尤其 8fb 不会为匹配原生标注而虚构 Agreement 终止事件，省略式句子和其他未覆盖解释仍进入 residual。
